targets.authors: Mayshar, J., Moav, O., and Pascali, L.
targets.title: The origin of the state: Land productivity or appropriability?
targets.evidence_quote: This is a replication of Mayshar et al. (2022) (henceforth MMP).
targets.outcome_computational_quote: The computational reproduction of Mayshar et al. (2022) confirms that their data and code closely reproduce the main results presented in their Table 1.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Our robustness replication with a range of plausible alternative specifications points to additional nuance and sometimes eroded support for the main results.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors confirm close numerical reproduction, treating small discrepancies as not changing qualitative interpretation. Alternative specifications erode support and sometimes contradict central claims. Both axes concern original data; added climate controls do not constitute a fresh participant sample.

reasoning: Complete EconStor paper including references matches title and four authors. Reanalysis of Mayshar et al. original data and code makes this reproduction despite authors terminology. Only Mayshar et al. is retested; historical source datasets and climate data are not additional targets.
